system.description:
You infused Medical Chakra on your hands as you putrefy it. Make a melee ninjutsu attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 2d12 Necrotic damage. Creatures that are treated as Plants or comprised of water are treated as vulnerable against this jutsu’s damage.

Affected creature(s) must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save old wounds begin to open and their muscles and bones bend as they are disarmed of any object they are holding.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d12. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can choose to turn this jutsu’s range into Self (20-Foot Radius) originating from a point on the space you occupy. All creatures, excluding the caster in range must make their Constitution saving throw taking this jutsu’s damage and are disarmed on a failed save or half as much on a successful save.

If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank all affected creatures with 100 or less hit points are immediately killed. Once you kill at least one creature with this jutsu in this way, you cannot upcast it to this rank again until you complete a Full-Rest.
